prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: second high-fidelity compositional option for the desktop landing page of “3DCreativeLab”, 1440×900 landscape, edge to edge, no browser frame or device.
Product and job: Colombian 3D-printing store; a visitor should understand professional printed objects, see a real product with price and availability, and open the catalog.
Visible Spanish content: “Piezas que salen del plano”, “Objetos impresos con precisión, disponibles o fabricados bajo pedido.”, CTA “Ver productos”, “Lámpara lunar — $ 89.000 COP — Disponible”, navigation “Productos”, “Personalizados”, “Cómo fabricamos”, “WhatsApp”.
Concept: product-led variation of the approved production-traveler world. A monumental matte white 3D-printed lunar lamp overlaps the black frame of one oversized red-and-white shop-floor traveler, as if the finished object has physically emerged from its production drawing. The offer, price, stock, material and CTA occupy purposeful zones on that single document surface; navigation is integrated at the top and the beginning of a manufacturing-process section is visible below.
Visual law: only vivid signal red, true black and white. White dominates; black carries type and structure; red owns action, active state and one full field. Bold utilitarian sans display and readable body. Crisp workshop-stock, rubber-ink and filament textures without aged paper.
One dominant object-emerging-from-plan move; all other content quiet and usable.
Constraints: no cream, green, blue, gradients, glass, floating pill nav, icon-card row, fake reviews, discounts, statistics, lorem ipsum, browser chrome or mockup device.
